messages:
nate: rolling canary v2026.05 -> 10% global in quiet window. please monitor SLOs: https://dash.redwood.local/slo/serve and call out p95/5xx/connection errors.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by nate. Version=v2026.05 Canary=10% Mode=quiet-window. Notifying @eng-oncall. CI: green.

maya: quick look: p95 for 'serve.text' normal, but 'serve.embed' p95 jumped to ~480ms in us-east-1 and 5xx rate up to 0.7% in the last 30s.

sre-oncall: seeing repeated upstream connection failures in proxy logs: `connect ECONNRESET` and `dial tcp: i/o timeout` from a subset of nodes. Could be connection pool exhaustion after the client-side change.

observability-bot: Alert: embeds-route 5xx > 0.5% for 1m in region=us-east-1. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.local/runbooks/deploy-triage.

nate: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot hold-ramp. adding note to release notes: "investigating us-east 5xx spike".

deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Canary frozen at 10%.

maya: digging traces -> high concurrent outbound sockets from the new worker processes. connection_pool_active ~= 600, configured max=600. We hit the pool ceiling and are getting resets.

sre-oncall: mitigation options: 1) regional route-pin to v2026.04 for us-east, 2) increase pool limit (needs infra change), 3) rollback globally. Fastest is regional pin. Recommend pin us-east to v2026.04 and continue canary elsewhere.

release-manager: agree pin is fastest. execute pin command and note in changelog. Also prepare rollback doc just in case.

nate: execute pin: @deploy-bot route-pin embeds.us-east-1 v2026.04 120m. Documenting mitigation in release notes.

deploy-bot: Route pin executed: embeds.us-east-1 -> v2026.04 for 120m. Canary continues in other regions at 10%.

maya: after pin, 5xx rate in us-east drops to baseline within 40s. p95 back to ~230ms. connection_pool_active down as requests drain.

sre-oncall: opening ticket ENG-OPS-512 to investigate pool sizing and client retry backoff. If similar symptoms appear in another region, we will either pin or disable the client change.

nate: resuming ramp to 25% in non-pinned regions with a 10m hold. @deploy-bot ramp-to 25% over 3m hold 10m. Tighten 5xx alerts.

deploy-bot: Ramp accepted. Abort conditions: 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms per region.

release-manager: updating release notes: "Regional pin applied for us-east due to connection pool exhaustion triggered by new client behavior; full investigation ticket ENG-OPS-512."

maya: will follow up with heap/profile dump and trace samples in the ticket. Thanks team. Keeping eyes on dashboards.
